subject: Dermal Fibroblast Senescence: The Hidden Driver of Skin Aging and Systemic Inflammation
script: From Agewell Brief: Dermal Fibroblast Senescence: The Hidden Driver of Skin Aging and Systemic Inflammation. New review maps how ROS-induced fibroblast senescence disrupts the extracellular matrix, fuels chronic inflammation, and accelerates aging across the body. ROS accumulation triggers fibroblast senescence and SASP-mediated inflammation. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
